# Independent audit: centroid-hull contraction and actual ascent

Target: `candidate 6a7efe79d654e5de`, Sections 1--5.

Result: full independent PASS. Reran the companion exact verifier: 1,241
checks PASS. No repair identified. The fixed-fan refinement described
separately below in the research thread is not needed for this audit.

## 1. Actual path and boundary speed

D is a convex subset of the original canonical hull, its sampled fibers
are compatible and contain g_z, and fiberwise Minkowski interpolation
preserves every anchored inclusion. The canonical hull of the new sampled
fibers has exactly those sections. D_z subset K_z gives nesting and the
displayed centered homothety gives a common positive inball for small t.

The support derivative is uniform on the full normal sphere because the
support path is exactly linear with a continuous difference. In radial
coordinates a common inball bounds active n dot omega away from zero;
active normals converge to the unique old normal at surface-a.e. point.
The stated normal speed follows from the scalar minimum envelope, and
the uniform radial O(t) bound permits dominated shell integration. This
retains the hypothesis that was absent in the earlier discontinuous
Minkowski-response example. Supporting-cap derivatives are correctly
left to the separate directional theory.

## 2. Surface contact sign

For fixed n the exact LP formula for h_Dz(n) is concave in z. Under the
stated NORMAL-PRESERVING physical coupling, actual boundary support
contact makes the h_K part a conditional equality. Consequently
integral Xi(h_K-h_D)=-J_D<=0. The repair identity has the correct sign:

    integral Xi(h_D-n dot g)=J_D-sum_z g_z dot F_z.

Equality means equality of the concave centroid-support roof in each
positive row, not a global affine centroid graph. This computation does
not use or identify the separately constructed volume coupling.

## 3. Global buffered interval calculation

For K_-=K_+=[-1,1], K_0=[-1,7], the actual numbers are M=12,
Sigma=11/3, and mixed centroid (0,2). The own energy at 2 is 15/2,
so delta=epsilon sqrt(55/24). For a positive continuous normal every
through-source cap contains own length 5+delta; the horizontal one
attains it with endpoints empty. For the negative sign the own length
is 3+delta and the oppositely shifted symmetric endpoint pair contributes
at least 2, attained by a finite steep tilt. Pure-base caps at zero
have mass 10. Thus the all-normal minimum at the source is exactly
5+delta.

The two displayed caps have strict endpoint statuses and proper own
traces, hence exact upper Q-quantiles. Their positive weighted source
inequalities reduce to the tangent inequality for the strictly concave
buffer, with derivative delta/15 at 2. Equality is impossible at any
other mark. Endpoint pure-base covers bound all other bases by 2.
This proves all-source uniqueness and global depth; no local menu is
silently substituted for the global lower bound.

Jensen at the TRUE original mixed centroid proves fixed-body global
optimality of L=1 over all positive concave log-normalized parameters.
The source correctly disclaims a joint body minimum and records the
failed singleton quota in this particular calibration.

## 4. Path derivatives and genuine ascent

The centroid hull has D_0=[0,3] and D_-=D_+={0}, yielding exactly the
three intervals in (13). Their coincident critical masses meet at
y(t)=2-t/2, with Q(t)=5-7t/2+delta(t). The two strict status gaps and
the buffer tangent proof persist for all small signed t; hence this is
the actual optimized depth, not only a cap upper bound.

Independent differentiation gives

    E'/E=-1/2-7/10+5/8=-23/40,
    Sigma'/Sigma=-21/11+3/4=-51/44,
    delta'/delta=(-51/44-23/40+3/4)/2=-433/880,
    beta'=1/48+227delta/10560>0.

Only the bottom middle endpoint has a nonzero centroid-hull repair, of
size 3. Independently collecting its Xi terms gives constant 1/12 and
delta coefficient

    -1/30-1/12+5/48+2/11-1/12=227/2640.

All fiber forces vanish, so the surface formula agrees exactly with
-M beta'. The concrete delta=1/10 numbers check. Negative t is actually
compatible here because both lower supports remain equal and the middle
upper support retains strict slack; thus its descent explains the lack
of joint minimality.

## 5. Planar reversal obstruction and quotas

The trapezoid has area 9 and centroid height -4/3 by direct integration
of its width 4+2y/3; the endpoint rectangles have area 6 and centroid
height -3/2. The rectangles are contained in the trapezoid, all singleton
quotas are strict, and the two adjacent closed-minor masses are 15<21.

At the upward normal, the OLD anchored support gap is exactly zero,
while the centroid-hull support gap is 1/6. Thus the proposed reversed
support path has gap -t/6. The fixed upper target cut gives height at
most 4t/3 whereas the exact homothetically expanded endpoints attain
3t/2. This proves actual incompatibility even if reverse bodies are
defined by all outward Wulff cuts. The failure is precisely one active
anchored support inequality, independent of individual facet turnover.
